issues.description: The problem statement titles the exercise as "H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon" (exercise identifier and domain name), but both repository settings use different project names: the template's settings.gradle sets rootProject.name = 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House' and the solution's settings.gradle sets rootProject.name = 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution'. This mismatched exercise/project naming across artifacts can confuse students about which exercise they are working on and makes locating the correct project or tests less straightforward.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the exercise/project identifier across artifacts. For example, set both settings.gradle files' rootProject.name to a value that matches the problem statement (e.g., 'H02E02---Panic-at-Seal-Saloon' or similar), or update the problem statement header to match the repository names. Ensure the same identifier appears in problem_statement.md and in settings.gradle of both template and solution repos.
